name: Colour-Coded Decorator Profiler
description: A custom wrapper decorator around cProfile that generates formatted, colour-coded terminal tables with call frequencies, execution time, and caller percentages.
highlights: Labels every function by kind (public, private, dunder, generator…) and gives each class its own colour, so a profile can be scanned at a glance
Shows each function's most frequent caller and what share of its calls came from there
Colour gradients pick out the slowest times, and file:line links jump straight to the code

media.caption: Profiling one turn of the Procedural Grid Game's game loop: rendering the visible tiles, and eight enemies path-finding with A* while the player digs
